what: Milestone 1 — Correctness fixes in the diagnostic backends (small, first)
title: bayesgrove restructuring plan (post thermonuclear review, 2026-07)
text: Divergence-rate denominator inconsistent factor n_chains. bg_cmdstanr_hmc_metrics() (R/backends-cmdstanr.R:96), num_transitions computed total post-warmup draws divided num_chains() (per-chain count), divergences summed across chains. bg_hmc_severity() computes divergence_rate = divergences / num_transitions, inflating rate chain count (4 chains, 1000 iters, 20 divergences → reported 2% instead 0.5%). Fix: define num_transitions total post-warmup transitions across chains (nrow(as_draws_matrix(draws))), update roxygen bg_hmc_severity(), align brms path (R/backends-brms.R currently sets num_transitions = NA_integer_ — compute draws). Add ground-truth unit test: 4 chains × 1000 draws 20 divergences must yield rate 0.005 severity "warning", "error", default 1% threshold. Existing fixtures test-backends.R pass num_transitions = 4000L directly remain valid. Substring matching draw variables. bg_executor_loo() uses grepl(log_lik_var, colnames(draws), fixed = TRUE) bg_executor_ppc() yrep_var (R/backends-cmdstanr.R:375,533). "log_lik" matches log_lik_extra[1]; "yrep" matches yrep_new[3]. Replace anchored matching Stan’s indexed-variable form: select columns matching ^<var>(\[|$) (escape var rex-style quoting utils::glob2rx-free manual regex), better, use posterior::subset_draws(draws, variable = var). code: bg_register_node_kind(handle, "scenario", executor = function(node, inputs) {   node$params })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "simulate_data", executor = function(node, inputs) {   scenario <- inputs[[1]]   set.seed(scenario$seed + node$params$seed_offset)    n <- scenario$n   z <- rnorm(n)   treatment_prob <- plogis(scenario$assignment_intercept + scenario$confounding * z)   treatment <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = treatment_prob)   outcome <- 0.5 + scenario$beta_treat * treatment + scenario$beta_z * z + rnorm(n, sd = scenario$sigma)    data <- data.frame(     z = z,     treatment = treatment,     outcome = outcome   )    list(     data = data,     truth = list(       beta_treat = scenario$beta_treat,       beta_z = scenario$beta_z,       confounding = scenario$confounding     ),     split = node$params$split   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "descriptive_check", executor = function(node, inputs) {   sim <- inputs[[1]]   data <- sim$data    treated <- data[data$treatment == 1, , drop = FALSE]   untreated <- data[data$treatment == 0, , drop = FALSE]   pooled_sd <- stats::sd(data$z)    list(     split = sim$split,     treated_share = mean(data$treatment),     mean_z_treated = mean(treated$z),     mean_z_untreated = mean(untreated$z),     z_smd = (mean(treated$z) - mean(untreated$z)) / pooled_sd,     cor_treatment_z = stats::cor(data$treatment, data$z)   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "fit_lm", executor = function(node, inputs) {   train <- inputs[[1]]   test <- inputs[[2]]   formula <- stats::as.formula(node$params$formula)    fit <- stats::lm(formula, data = train$data)   predictions <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = test$data)   rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$data$outcome - predictions)^2))    estimate <- unname(stats::coef(fit)[["treatment"]])    list(     model_label = node$label,     formula = node$params$formula,     estimate = estimate,     absolute_effect_error = abs(estimate - train$truth$beta_treat),     predictive_rmse = rmse   ) })  bg_register_node_kind(handle, "compare_models", executor = function(node, inputs) {   naive <- inputs[[1]]   adjusted <- inputs[[2]]   descriptive <- inputs[[3]]    ranking <- data.frame(     model = c(naive$model_label, adjusted$model_label),     absolute_effect_error = c(       naive$absolute_effect_error,       adjusted$absolute_effect_error     ),     predictive_rmse = c(naive$predictive_rmse, adjusted$predictive_rmse)   )    ranking <- ranking[order(ranking$absolute_effect_error, ranking$predictive_rmse), ]    list(     imbalance = descriptive,     ranking = ranking,     recommended = ranking$model[[1]]   ) })

Practitioner shortcuts bg_fit_stan() bg_fit_brms() collapse data-node + fit-node + run sequence one call (experimental). bg_bundle() records reproducibility manifest (R version, platform, package versions, CmdStan version) bundle; bg_open() warns restored bundle produced different environment. bg_next_actions() results blocked bg_run() handles print protocol-aware checklists: held nodes show hold reason, obligations render severity glyphs copy-pasteable resolving call.
